description: APPEND-ONLY status history for funding transactions and loan payments (architecture v1.2 D16). Gold for audits: no status of fundingTransactions/loanPayments ever changes without an INSERT here in the same transaction, recording who, when, why, from which ip/device. Rows are NEVER updated or deleted — history accumulates, it is not edited.

fields.name: subjectId
fields.description: fundingId or paymentId depending on subjectType.

fields.name: actorUserId
fields.description: User that caused the transition. NULL only for system crons (escalations, expirations).

fields.name: ipAddress
fields.description: Actor ip captured from the observability middleware.

fields.name: deviceInfo
fields.description: Actor device captured from the observability middleware.

relationships.notes: Multi-tenant isolation via companyId — injected automatically by stored procedures.

components.name: PaymentHistoryListStep
components.description: IonList newest-first by companyId filtered by subjectType+subjectId: oldStatus→newStatus, actor, reason, created_At. Read-only timeline.

hints: APPEND-ONLY: the SP implements action 1 (insert) and reads; actions 2 (update) and 3 (delete) must return an error — history is never edited.
